description: North star: compile work proportional to input; things nothing uses create no work or artifacts. fixtures/00420_enum_take_drop_split.fz uses only integers yet lowers 18 float/mixed Kernel operator externs (fz_op_add_ff, fz_op_eq_ff/fi/if, fz_op_gt/lt/rem/sub_*, fz_value_cmp_ref), each costing LowerFunction and DeriveFunctionContract jobs. Cause (fact): + and == are single multi-clause functions (lib/kernel.fz:293,297,681,687); LowerFunction lowers every clause, and body_static_callees (jobs/keying.rs:107-131) walks static_edges over the whole lowered body with no clause-reachability filter, so every extern named in any clause gets a static edge and is lowered. Direction: static callees come from clauses dispatch can select for the demanded activations (dispatch-aware edges), so an unreached clause's callees are never demanded. Investigate (paper-first) before a design: which facts need whole-body edges today (call-graph components, recursion) and whether edges can be keyed per activation. Done when 00420 lowers none of the 18 and every work pin that moves drops.
title: Nothing unused creates work: a static edge exists only from a clause dispatch can select
